intro.title: Welcome to Lakbay Rizal
intro.card1Body: Travel stop by stop across the Philippines, Asia, Europe and America. Each stop is a pixel-art scene of that place in that year.
intro.card2Body: Open a stop on the map, read the short story in the dialogue, then answer two questions. Each stop you finish adds a stamp to your passport.
intro.card3Body: Guided opens the stops in order, one at a time. Free explore opens every stop now. You can switch at any time on the map.
